groups.name: grails.gorm.sqlTail
groups.description: SQL statement capture for the sql-tail command

properties.name: dataSource.driverClassName
properties.description: The JDBC driver class name. When not set, the connection pool derives the driver from the JDBC URL.

properties.name: dataSource.username
properties.description: The database username. When not set, connections are opened without a username. H2 applications usually set sa.

properties.name: dataSource.password
properties.description: The database password. When not set, connections are opened without a password. H2 applications usually set an empty password.

properties.name: dataSource.dbCreate
properties.description: The schema generation strategy: create-drop, create, update, validate, or none, use none in production with a migration tool. The default applies in every environment; generated applications set it per environment in application.yml.

properties.name: dataSource.pooled
properties.description: Whether to use a connection pool.

properties.name: dataSource.logSql
properties.description: Whether to log SQL statements to stdout.

properties.name: dataSource.formatSql
properties.description: Whether to format logged SQL for readability.

properties.name: dataSource.dialect
properties.description: The Hibernate dialect class name or class.

properties.name: dataSource.readOnly
properties.description: Whether the DataSource is read-only (calls setReadOnly(true) on connections).

properties.name: dataSource.transactional
properties.description: For additional datasources, whether to include in the chained transaction manager.

properties.name: dataSource.persistenceInterceptor
properties.description: For additional datasources, whether to wire up the persistence interceptor (the default datasource is always wired).

properties.name: dataSource.jmxExport
properties.description: Whether to register JMX MBeans for Tomcat JDBC pool DataSources that set jmxEnabled in their properties.

properties.name: dataSource.type
properties.description: The connection pool implementation class when multiple are on the classpath.

properties.name: grails.gorm.sqlTail.enabled
properties.description: Whether Hibernate records every SQL statement it runs, with the controller and action serving the request, to the file the sql-tail command tails. Off by default: an application started without it carries no statement inspector. Turned on for one run by grails run-app --sql-tail or ./gradlew bootRun -Pgrails.gorm.sqlTail.enabled.

properties.name: grails.gorm.sqlTail.file
properties.description: The file captured statements are written to, absolute or relative to the working directory. When not set the file is sql-tail/capture.log under the build directory, where the sql-tail command looks for it.
